prog='''def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    div = next(i for i, r in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in r))
    top = grid[:div]
    bot = grid[div+1:]
    counts = {}
    for c in (2, 4):
        counts[c] = (sum(r.count(c) for r in top), sum(r.count(c) for r in bot))
    def growth(c):
        a, b = counts[c]
        return (b - a, -c)  # tie -> smaller color
    winner = max(counts, key=growth)
    cols = {j for r in top for j, v in enumerate(r) if v != 0}
    side = len(cols)
    return [[winner]*side for _ in range(side)]
'''
